messages:
emma: oncall-bot just paged me: us-west-2 GPU queue spiked to 9.2k and we've seen ~45% spike in throttled requests. Spot pool preemptions reported. Starting thread to coordinate triage.

oncall-bot: ALERT 2095012345 - high_queue_depth - channel=incidents severity=sev2 queue_depth=9200 preemptions=12 spot_pool=spot-usw2-gpu-pool

raj: looking. quick checks — autoscaler logs show repeated FailedCreateInstance due to "quotaExceeded" from cloud provider. autoscaler tried to spin up ondemand fallback but hit project vCPUs quota for GPUs.

li: confirmed from infra side: quota for NVIDIA A100 gpus in project is at limit in region. Cloud console shows pending quota increase requests for another team. Also seeing API 429s from cloud provider on instance create calls.

dana: customers reporting elevated latencies and a few timeout CX tickets (enterprise customers). @dana to triage impact: affected routes are /v1/generate and /v1/chat for gpt-neox-20b variants. Most traffic is from Dedicated tenants pinned to spot pools.

mike: temporary mitigation idea — route non-critical Dedicated tenants to smaller model variants (gpt-neo-6b) and divert public hosted API traffic to regional ondemand pool if we can provision manually. can also enable queued request backpressure to reject low-priority requests.

emma: agreed. immediate action list:
- determine exact quota error and escalate to cloud support (raj)
- if quota increase ETA > 2h, manually add capacity by converting some reserved ondemand instances from infra pre-prod (li)
- toggle routing policy: disable spot preference for public-hosted -> route to ondemand-usw2-gpu-pool (emma)
- apply temporary per-tenant throttles / reject low-priority queued work (mike)
- notify customers on status page / update support (dana)

raj: fetching autoscaler tail:

```
2026-03-15T21:45:10Z autoscaler: Scaling attempt for pool spot-usw2-gpu-pool -> desired=50 current=24
2026-03-15T21:45:11Z cloudapi: CreateInstance(ondemand-usw2-1) -> 429 RateLimitExceeded
2026-03-15T21:45:12Z cloudapi: CreateInstance(ondemand-usw2-2) -> 403 quotaExceeded: "Project GPU quota exceeded"
2026-03-15T21:45:12Z autoscaler: failed to scale fallback pool ondemand-usw2-gpu-pool: last_error=quotaExceeded
```

li: manual capacity check shows ondemand-usw2-gpu-pool has 6 spare slots but other teams consuming 80% reserved. I can reclaim 4 by stopping some scheduled pre-prod nodes. Will do 1-2 min ops.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE 2095012400 - action_taken: reclaimed 4 ondemand nodes for redwood-inference team, routing policy set to prefer-ondemand for hosted-api

dana: posting customer note draft to status page now. short blurb: "We are seeing elevated request latency and transient errors for some GPU-backed models in us-west-2 due to capacity pressure. We're routing traffic to ondemand capacity and working with cloud partner on quota increases."

mike: applying per-tenant soft-throttle rule for non-SLA traffic: set rate_limit=0.5rps per tenant for gpt-neox-20b in us-west-2. also adding a fallback prompt to instruct clients to retry after jittered backoff.

emma: hands-on keyboard for routing toggle. Running route-change command:

```
# promote ondemand for hosted-api routes
curl -X POST "https://internal-routing.redwood/api/v1/route/toggle" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ROUTE_ADMIN}" \
  -d '{"region":"us-west-2","prefer":"ondemand","target_routes":["/v1/generate","/v1/chat"]}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy started by emma for routing-change (run id: r-7521). logs: "start -> checking pool compatibility -> switch_streams"

raj: autoscaler recovering from 429 bursts now but quotaExceeded persists for new instance types. cloud support ticket opened (CS-98721) with priority P1; ETA quoted 3-6 hours for hard quota increase. I escalated verbally.

li: manual reclaim complete: freed 4 nodes, added 8 GPUs to ondemand-usw2-gpu-pool via infra-preprod conversion. Note: this reduces pre-prod capacity; ops teams notified.

oncall-bot: METRIC UPDATE 2095012560 - queue_depth=2100 throttled=6% avg_lat=3200ms

dana: customer impact update: ticket backlog reduced, but enterprise tenant "Acadia" reported 5 failed requests earlier - support contacting them with remediation and credit offer.

mike: continuing rate limit config and adding a short circuit for requests that will exceed per-request cost, returning 429 with Retry-After for lowest priority traffic.

emma: handing off to next oncall in 30m. summary for handoff:
- root cause: spot pool preemptions + autoscaler blocked by cloud GPU quota -> insufficient ondemand fallback capacity
- mitigations applied: reclaimed nodes, toggled routing to ondemand, applied per-tenant throttles, escalated quota increase
- customer impact: elevated latencies, timeouts for some customers (esp. Dedicated pinned to spot pools). ongoing mitigation until quota increased.

emma: @raj @li please continue to monitor cloud ticket and autoscaler logs. @dana please coordinate support comms. I'll update the incident channel if anything changes before handoff.

raj: will follow up. posting a short checklist for postmortem:
- (1) why quota was at limit and why reserve requests were pending (billing/ops ownership)
- (2) why autoscaler didn't pre-warm ondemand earlier (policy gap)
- (3) add a hard-fallback runbook for immediate manual capacity reclamation
- (4) improve alerting thresholds to include "fallback capacity < X GPUs" and quota errors

li: adding infra action items: request cross-team quota reservation, automate emergency conversion of preprod nodes into ondemand pool, add cloud API retry/backoff for instance creation.

dana: tagging customer-impact owners and starting the initial postmortem doc.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED 2095012900 - final_queue_depth=420 last_checked=2095012900 resolution=manual_reclaim + routing + throttles

mike: deploying the throttles as permanent circuit breakers for low-priority tenants — will follow up with logs/metrics in the morning.

emma: thanks everyone. assigning postmortem owner: raj. target: draft postmortem in 72h. :white_check_mark:
